scope: 9 x 9 open-circuit port impedance matrix, one LU reused for nine 1 A right-hand sides per frequency, full six-wall frequency solve
limitation: ports are k x k axial edge bundles (E_axial forced to zero); the lateral post surface is not enforced; each port is a wall delta gap, not a coaxial/SMA opening with an outer conductor and reference plane; the 3 x 3 lattice and the 7/2 role split are a nominal study arrangement, not a design; the diagonal differs from sections 23/24/26 because all nine posts are present at once

port_roles.mapping: index 0..6 = P1..P7, index 7..8 = R1, R2 (row-major over the lattice)
